inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned car from Cairo Airport to your hotel in Cairo or Giza
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned car meets you at Cairo Airport and delivers you to your hotel in Cairo or Giza — no queues, no guesswork.

inclusions.text: Representative meets you in the arrivals hall and escorts you to the vehicle
inclusions.source: The arrangement is straightforward: a representative meets you in the arrivals hall, escorts you to a private air-conditioned vehicle, and drives you to your hotel in Cairo or Giza.

exclusions.text: Visa, immigration, and luggage are still yours to handle
exclusions.source: Visa, immigration, and luggage are still yours to handle — your representative meets you on the public side of arrivals.

exclusions.text: Not a guided orientation; the driver does not narrate
exclusions.source: It is not a guided orientation; the driver is there to deliver you safely, not to narrate.
